notes: Not approved and not published. The owner approves every post (npm run approve) after seeing the render and every caption.

Facts: GUIDED = "The coach calls every move and keeps time."; AT YOUR PACE = "The moves and a timer. Beeps, no coach voice." (data/loadoutMissions.js GUIDED_HELP / SOLO_HELP). ROUND ends each round except the last, which ends with FINISH; a 1-round mission has FINISH only (soloFromGenerated tapHint: "Tap ROUND when a round is done. FINISH after the last."). The clip must use 10 minutes or more for ROUND to show.

The generated mission at your pace is a count-up circuit: rests are yours and the clock keeps counting, so the reel never says the timer "ends at N minutes". The "CAP 20:00" under the timer is the app's own (twice the standard pace).
The same moves run either way ("Runs exactly the workout on the card, GUIDED or AT YOUR PACE", START guide), which is why the card says "Same moves".
"Your pick is kept" is in the captions only: the START guide says the choice is kept for next time and START on Fit Mode and Home follows it.
No fast-forwarded clock on screen: the get-ready and the first seconds of the timer are real time in the clip; each scene's window sits on one side of the clip's one clock jump.

Footage: each scene's window in the clip is in "timeline". The clips are recorded from the live app by npm run app-broll (needs a built export of the app); after the app changes, re-run it and re-check every window.
